quote.quote: No AC meeting has been held in connection with this application.
An AC meeting was not held. There was no interaction with consultants, special government employees, or patient stakeholders.
The application was not reviewed before an advisory committee.

no_adcom_quote.quote: The application did not raise precedent- setting regulatory or scientific issues. For this reasons no advisory committee meeting was necessary.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for NDA208547 (NETSPOT / Ga 68 dotatate). The Summary Review states the application did not raise precedent-setting regulatory or scientific issues, so no AC meeting was necessary; the Cross-Discipline Team Leader review, Office/Division Director memo, and Medical Review all independently confirm no AC meeting was held. In lieu of an AC, the application was discussed at an internal regulatory briefing in the Office of New Drugs, and there are therefore no AC-driven linkages to the approval.
